HetrixToolsAPIKeyCredential.title: HetrixToolsAPIKeyCredential
HetrixToolsAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing v3 API key. Bearer headers go only to api.hetrixtools.com/v3. Connection reads GET /account/api/scope: actual permitted calls/assets, not principal or tenant identity. This node does not use legacy key-in-path APIs or issue keys. Monitor child reads additionally require GET Uptime Monitors for an independent parent witness. The provider enforces endpoint and asset permissions; scope names are not guessed.
